mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_composite_report_section WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY display_order, id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_composite_report_section section_row JOIN ai_composite_report_task task_row ON task_row.task_id = section_row.task_id SET section_row.snapshot_id = NULL, section_row.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE section_row.task_id = #{taskId} AND task_row.expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND task_row.status = 'EXPIRED' AND section_row.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
